name: buggy_python
description: Seeded candidate findings for the demo pipeline. Until the discovery and patch agents exist, BlackForge reads candidates and reference patches from this file; the Referee and verifier still decide every verdict by running pytest.

findings.description: rolling_mean fails when a valid window contains None values.
findings.expected_behavior: Return a valid rolling result while treating None as missing.
findings.observed_behavior: TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'float' and 'NoneType'

reference_patch.explanation: Skip None values inside each full window and return None when a window has no values, so missing data is treated as missing instead of crashing sum().
reference_patch.patch:
--- a/src/analytics/rolling.py
+++ b/src/analytics/rolling.py
@@ -19,9 +19,11 @@
         if len(window_vals) < window:
             results.append(None)
             continue
-        # Intentionally naive — blows up when None is present.
-        total = sum(window_vals)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
-        results.append(total / len(window_vals))
+        present = [v for v in window_vals if v is not None]
+        if not present:
+            results.append(None)
+            continue
+        results.append(sum(present) / len(present))
     return results
